notes: Modified cash basis school district. Governmental lines use the Total Governmental Funds column (p8, p10), which already eliminates 240,000 of General Fund pupil transportation transferred to Depreciation Fund (Adjustments column) and interfund transfers, leaving net transfer out 52,028 to School Nutrition (business-type). Governmental roll-forward: 2,266,606 + 4,577,760 - 4,385,175 - 52,028 = 2,407,163. Business-type: 7,218 + 84,827 - 141,285 + 52,028 = 2,788. Miscellaneous receipts 274,758 split using fund columns/schedules (205,266 Activities Fund + 60,686 + 2,003 other-district/ESU + 3,563 postsecondary + 3,240 misc). Other Support Services 408,323 split by fund column (p9): General 103,526 + Depreciation 86,577 support services, Activities 218,220 student activities. Property Tax Credit and Other State Receipts kept as printed (all state aid). Beginning cash = beginning fund balance total (p10). Balance sheet is the government-wide Total column (cash basis; no liabilities). Detail: General Fund budget schedule shows functions only (not itemized); General Fund pupil transportation line recorded net of the 240,000 hidden transfer. Activities Fund detail: the full per-account schedule (trimmed pp22-23, report pp49-50) is recorded account by account (nonzero cells only: receipts, disbursements, transfers in(out) as other financing, signed); it supersedes the one-line Activities budget schedule (p19), which is left out to avoid double counting. Per-account receipts sum to 205,864, disbursements 218,220 and transfers 33,200, matching the printed totals row (p23) and the statement. Student activity receipts use category charges for services/fees because the receipt category list has no student activities; account Interest recorded as investment income and Library Fines as fines and forfeitures. Transfer cross-check: GF transfers out 85,228 = Activities 33,200 + Nutrition 52,028 matches; Depreciation 240,000 matches hidden transfer. Read pages 1-23 of 23
